products.h1: Trigger — Smart Automatic Water Level Controller for Municipal Supply
products.metaTitle: Trigger | Smart Municipal Water Level Controller | Aquabrim
products.metaDescription: Trigger by Aquabrim auto-detects municipal water supply and runs your motor to fill tanks automatically. Features dry-run protection, overflow prevention and RF wireless sensors. Trusted by 50,000+ homes.
longDescription: Trigger is Aquabrim's flagship automatic water level controller designed specifically for Indian homes, apartments, and commercial buildings that depend on municipal corporation water supply. Built after years of dedicated R&D for Indian metropolitan cities, Trigger solves one of the most common household frustrations — missing the water supply and ending up with an empty tank.

Unlike conventional float switches or manual motor controllers, Trigger uses advanced RF-based wireless sensor technology to detect water availability in your municipal supply line within minutes — even if the water is up to 50 metres away from the motor, or if the motor is installed on the first floor. The moment water is detected, Trigger automatically starts the motor, fills your overhead tank, and shuts the motor down intelligently — preventing overflow, protecting the motor from dry-run damage, and ensuring your tank is always optimally filled without any human intervention.

Designed with intelligent automation logic, wireless connectivity and multiple safety protections, Trigger is the perfect home automation tool for busy urban households. It requires no wiring between the roof tank and the controller unit — everything communicates wirelessly, making installation clean, simple, and completely maintenance-free.

faqs.question: What is the Aquabrim Trigger?
faqs.answer: Trigger is Aquabrim's smart automatic water level controller designed for homes and apartments that receive water from a municipal corporation (city) supply line. It automatically detects when water supply arrives, starts your motor to fill the tank, and stops the motor when the tank is full — all without any manual intervention.

faqs.question: How does Trigger detect municipal water supply?
faqs.answer: Trigger uses a specially designed PRSR transmitter connected to your main water inlet pipe. This sensor continuously monitors the supply line and detects water availability within minutes — even if the supply point is up to 50 metres away from the motor or the motor is installed on an upper floor.

faqs.question: Does Trigger require wiring between the tank and the controller?
faqs.answer: No. Trigger uses RF (Radio Frequency) wireless technology. The tank-level sensors communicate wirelessly with the controller unit — no wiring from the roof or underground tank to the controller is needed. This makes installation much simpler and cleaner.

faqs.question: What is dry run protection in Trigger?
faqs.answer: Dry run protection automatically stops the motor if water supply is interrupted while the motor is running. This prevents the motor from running without water, which can cause overheating, bearing damage, and expensive motor burnout.

faqs.question: Can Trigger work if my building receives water at irregular hours?
faqs.answer: Yes. Trigger monitors the supply line continuously on a real-time basis, so it will detect and respond to supply regardless of what time it arrives. If your supply is at a fixed time, you can also use the built-in timer mode.

faqs.question: Can Trigger control multiple tanks?
faqs.answer: Yes. If your motor fills more than one tank, additional wireless sensors can be installed in each tank. Trigger will display and control the water levels of all connected tanks simultaneously.

faqs.question: How do I manually start the motor using Trigger?
faqs.answer: Press the Trigger button on the controller for 5 seconds until you hear a beep. The motor will start and check for water supply. If no water is detected within 3 minutes, the motor will stop automatically to prevent dry running.

faqs.question: What happens if there is a power surge or voltage fluctuation?
faqs.answer: Trigger includes voltage protection that monitors the power supply and stops the motor if the voltage becomes unsafe. The built-in fuse also protects the internal controller circuit from power spikes and surges.

faqs.question: Is the Trigger water level controller easy to install?
faqs.answer: Yes. The complete kit includes all components needed for a standard installation — transmitters, holders, pipe connectors, mounting screws and the controller unit. Installation involves mounting the controller on a wall, fixing transmitters in the tanks, and connecting the PRSR sensor to the inlet pipe. No special tools are needed beyond a standard masonry drill.

faqs.question: Where is Aquabrim Trigger manufactured?
faqs.answer: Trigger is designed, manufactured and marketed by Aquabrim Pvt. Ltd., based in Ghitorni, New Delhi, India — specifically engineered for Indian metropolitan cities after years of R&D.

products.h1: Macro — Wireless Automatic Water Level Controller for Borewell & Submersible Pumps
products.metaTitle: Macro | Wireless Automatic Water Level Controller for Borewell & Submersible Pumps | Aquabrim
products.metaDescription: Macro by Aquabrim automates borewell and submersible pump motors, filling overhead tanks from underground sources with dry run protection, overflow prevention and RF wireless sensors.
longDescription: Macro is Aquabrim's wireless automatic water level controller purpose-built for borewell and submersible pump automation. Designed for homes, apartments and commercial buildings that draw water from an underground source, Macro solves the everyday hassle of manually switching motors on and off, and the risk of motor damage from running dry.

Macro uses RF-based wireless sensor technology to continuously track water levels in the underground tank (or borewell) and the overhead tank, with no wiring required between the tanks and the controller unit. The moment the overhead tank falls below 50%, Macro automatically starts the motor and fills the tank, shutting it down intelligently once full — protecting the motor from dry-run damage and preventing overflow, all without any human intervention.

Built with intelligent automation logic, wireless connectivity and multiple safety protections, Macro is suitable for the Macro and iBot controller models. It is the reliable automation choice for households and buildings running borewell or submersible pumps, with clean, maintenance-free installation.

faqs.question: What is the Aquabrim Macro?
faqs.answer: Macro is Aquabrim's smart wireless controller built for borewell and submersible pump automation. It automatically starts your motor to pump water from an underground source into your overhead tank, and stops it once the tank is full — all without manual switching.

faqs.question: How does Macro know when to start the motor?
faqs.answer: Macro continuously monitors the water level in your overhead tank using a wireless level transmitter. The moment the level falls below 50%, it automatically starts the motor to begin refilling.

faqs.question: Does Macro require an underground tank, or can it work directly with a borewell?
faqs.answer: Macro can be used with an underground tank, or connected directly to a borewell or submersible pump. If it is used purely for borewell automation, the underground tank transmitter is not required.

faqs.question: What is dry run protection in Macro?
faqs.answer: Dry run protection stops the motor automatically if the underground tank level drops below 20% while filling, or if water flow into the tank is interrupted for more than 2 minutes. This prevents motor burnout from running without water.

faqs.question: When does Macro restart the motor after a dry run stop?
faqs.answer: Once the underground tank level recovers to at least 30%, Macro automatically restarts the motor to resume filling the overhead tank.

faqs.question: Does Macro require wiring between the tank and the controller?
faqs.answer: No. Macro uses RF (Radio Frequency) wireless technology. The tank sensors send data wirelessly to the controller unit, so no wiring is needed between the tanks and the controller.

faqs.question: Can Macro control more than one overhead tank?
faqs.answer: Yes. If your motor fills more than one tank, additional wireless sensors can be installed in each tank so Macro can display and automatically control the water level of all of them.

faqs.question: How do I manually start the motor with Macro?
faqs.answer: Press and hold the Trigger button for 5 seconds until you hear a beep. The motor starts immediately and fills all connected overhead tanks, then stops automatically once they are full.

faqs.question: Is the Macro controller easy to install?
faqs.answer: Yes. The kit includes the controller unit, UG and OH tank level transmitters, transmitter holders, mounting hardware and an optional flow sensor. Installation involves fixing the transmitters in the tanks, connecting the controller to the motor circuit, and mounting the controller on a wall using a standard masonry drill.

faqs.question: Where is the Aquabrim Macro manufactured?
faqs.answer: Macro is designed, manufactured and marketed by Aquabrim Pvt. Ltd., based in Ghitorni, New Delhi, India, and is suitable for the Macro and iBot controller models.

products.title: MATRIX
products.h1: Matrix — Wireless Motor Controller & Water Level Indicator for Large Buildings
products.metaTitle: Matrix | Wireless Water Level Controller for Multi-Tank & BMS Automation | Aquabrim
products.metaDescription: Matrix by Aquabrim is a wireless water level controller for large buildings, automating up to 13 overhead tanks and 2 motors with MODBUS based BMS integration.
longDescription: Matrix is Aquabrim's most versatile wireless water level controller, engineered for large residential complexes, commercial buildings and institutional sites that need centralized control over their water supply. Unlike compact single-tank controllers, Matrix is built to scale — automating water levels for up to 13 overhead tanks and 1 underground tank from a single unit.

Every sensor communicates wirelessly with the controller in the 433 to 434 MHz RF band, removing the need for wiring between tanks and the control room. Matrix runs 2 motors in flexible combinations decided at the time of installation, and can also display the open or close status of motorized valves installed near tanks, giving facility teams full visibility over the water system.

Matrix is fully configurable on site, with adjustable overflow, full and low level thresholds, up to 10 programmable timers and MODBUS connectivity that lets its data feed directly into a Building Management System (BMS) for remote monitoring and control. It is manufactured and supported by Aquabrim, built for demanding, always-on water automation.

products.title: Wireless water level transmitter ( Capacitive)
products.description: Continuous capacitive level sensing for deep tanks and borewells.
products.longDescription: The Capacitive Wireless Water Level Transmitter is an advanced solution for high-accuracy, continuous liquid level measurement. Built around a robust capacitive rod probe, the transmitter measures the change in electrical capacitance as liquid rises or falls along its length. Unlike mechanical float switches, it has no moving parts to clog or jam, making it exceptionally reliable in varying liquid types, deep tanks, and challenging environments. A built-in wireless transmitter sends absolute level data in real-time to the main Aquabrim controller.

howItWorks.title: Capacitive Field Analysis
howItWorks.desc: Measures changing dielectric capacitance along the probe rod as water levels change.

howItWorks.title: Real-Time Level Digitization
howItWorks.desc: Converts capacitance values into a precise level percentage or height measurement.

howItWorks.title: Wireless Broadcast
howItWorks.desc: Periodically sends data packets to the primary receiver without complex wiring.

products.title: Current & Voltage monitoring system
products.description: Advanced electrical health monitoring and pump safety system.
products.longDescription: The Smart Phase & Current Monitor is a robust electrical protection and diagnostic module designed to protect heavy-duty industrial pump starters and motors. It continuously monitors incoming voltage levels, phase synchronization, load current, and power factor in real-time. Upon detecting electrical faults such as single-phasing, phase reversal, overvoltage, undervoltage, or overload current, it triggers an instant safe-shutdown command to save expensive motors from winding burnouts. Featuring integrated wireless communication, the electrical telemetry is fed directly into building SCADA and command dashboards.

howItWorks.title: Real-Time Electrical Sensing
howItWorks.desc: Measures voltage and current across all phases continuously.

howItWorks.title: Immediate Fault Detection
howItWorks.desc: Identifies phase imbalances, single-phasing, or overload spikes.

howItWorks.title: Instant Pump Protection
howItWorks.desc: Trips the starter immediately to prevent motor burnout, logging the fault details.

products.title: Flow Meter
products.description: High-precision wireless electromagnetic flow monitoring system.
products.longDescription: Aquabrim's Wireless Electromagnetic Flow Meter is a next-generation solution for high-accuracy liquid flow measurement in commercial, industrial, and municipal supply pipelines. Employing state-of-the-art electromagnetic principles, the system accurately detects flow velocity and volume without any moving parts, minimizing pressure drops and eliminating wear and tear. Equipped with advanced wireless telemetry, the flow meter transmits real-time flow rate data and totalized volume directly to Aquabrim's central controllers or cloud command platform, enabling seamless automated leakage detection and consumption analysis.

products.longDescription: The Wireless Temperature & Humidity Sensor provides real-time, high-precision climate tracking inside critical control panels, motor starter rooms, and server infrastructure. Continuous exposure to high humidity or excessive temperatures can lead to early component failures and motor insulation breakdowns. This sensor transmits ambient atmospheric data continuously to the central command centre, triggering automated ventilation control or safety alarms when preset thresholds are breached, ensuring complete operational health.

howItWorks.title: Atmospheric Condition Measurement
howItWorks.desc: High sensitivity sensor elements measure temperature and relative humidity continuously.

howItWorks.title: Wireless Telemetry

howItWorks.title: Proactive Alarming

products.title: Wireless water level transmitter ( Non Contact)
products.description: Radar and ultrasonic non-contact level transmitter for open sumps.
products.longDescription: The Non-Contact Ultrasonic Level Transmitter utilizes advanced acoustic ranging to measure liquid levels without touching the medium. Positioned at the top of a tank or open sump, the sensor emits high-frequency sound pulses and measures the time-of-flight of the echo. This non-contact approach is ideal for sewage, acidic, or turbulent environments where physical contact would lead to probe degradation or scale build-up. The integrated wireless transmitter eliminates the need for expensive structural cabling, sending raw level information straight to the command gateway.

howItWorks.title: Ultrasonic Acoustic Ranging
howItWorks.desc: Emits high-frequency sound waves downward and listens for reflections.

howItWorks.title: Time-of-Flight Computation
howItWorks.desc: Calculates liquid depth based on reflection travel times.

howItWorks.title: Wireless Telemetry
howItWorks.desc: Reports exact height measurements directly to level controllers or smart displays.

products.description: Unified dashboard and command hub for site-wide water systems.
products.longDescription: The Integrated Control & Command Centre (ICCC) is a centralized, high-performance console that aggregates telemetry from all controllers, transmitters, flow meters, and current monitors across a commercial campus, residential complex, or manufacturing site. It provides facilities managers with a comprehensive, single-screen dashboard illustrating total water storage, real-time consumption rates, electrical motor health, and alarm statuses. With cloud compatibility, operators can monitor system health, override valve controls, and analyze consumption trends from anywhere.

products.title: Motorized Valve
products.description: Heavy-duty automated control valves with wireless triggering.
products.longDescription: The Aquabrim Wireless Motorised Valve System is designed for robust and automated routing of water across large-scale commercial and industrial tank networks. Fully integrated with our level controllers, this system eliminates manual valve operation entirely. The valve utilizes an electric actuator linked to a high-torque gearbox, ensuring reliable open and close operations even under high line pressure. Real-time status updates are sent wirelessly to the controller, allowing for multi-tank filling coordination, dynamic flow diverting, and automatic overflow prevention.

Supporting GPRS, WiFi, and RS485/Modbus connectivity, it securely collects real-time data from controllers, transmitters, flow meters, and sensors and relays it to the Aquabrim cloud dashboard and mobile app. With its rugged enclosure, external antenna, and reliable power supply, the gateway enables remote monitoring, instant alerts, and centralized control across single or multiple sites.

products.title: Wireless Signal Booster
products.description: Extends wireless range between transmitters and the main controller.
products.longDescription: The Aquabrim Wireless Signal Booster (Repeater) extends the wireless communication range between water level transmitters, sensors, and the main controller. In large buildings, basements, or sites with thick walls and long distances, radio signals can weaken before reaching the receiver. The booster captures these signals and re-transmits them at full strength, ensuring reliable, uninterrupted data flow across the entire installation without additional wiring.

howItWorks.title: Amplifies & Re-transmits

howItWorks.title: Extends Coverage

products.title: Lidar based level sensor
products.description: Non-contact LiDAR level sensing for precise, maintenance-free measurement.
products.longDescription: The Aquabrim LiDAR Based Level Sensor uses laser time-of-flight technology to measure water level without ever touching the liquid. Mounted above the tank or sump, it emits a focused laser pulse and calculates the exact distance to the water surface from the reflected light. Because there is no physical contact, it is unaffected by scale, foam, or chemicals, making it ideal for sewage, corrosive, and high-accuracy applications. Level data is transmitted wirelessly to the Aquabrim controller in real time.

howItWorks.desc: Emits a laser pulse and measures how long the reflection takes to return.

howItWorks.title: Precise Distance Calculation

howItWorks.title: Wireless Reporting
howItWorks.desc: Sends real-time level data to the controller without contact or wiring in the tank.
